chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥafṣ, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the one who had fainted. He said: then he said, he makes up the salat (prayer) of one day.

key_terms.الْمُغْمَىٰ عَلَيْهِ: a person who has fallen unconscious or fainted
key_terms.يَقْضِي: he performs as qada', making up an obligation after its time
key_terms.يَوْمٍ: one day, specifying the extent of the make-up

ai.seo_question: How much salat (prayer) must a person make up after being unconscious according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who was unconscious. It states that such a person is to make up one day's salat (prayer), indicating a specific limit in the required qada' after fainting.
